data.name: Eversole
data.long_meaning: The name Eversole is derived from the Latin word 'Ever' meaning eternal and 'Sole' meaning sun. This name signifies a person who is as steadfast and enduring as the sun itself.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the eternal and unchanging nature of God's love.

in_english.name: Eversole
in_english.long_meaning: English name derived from the Old English words 'efer' (ever) and 'soul' (flowing). It can mean 'ever-flowing' or 'servant of God'.
